Create an FTP or FTPS connection description

Source: R/connection-ftp.R
ftp.Rd

Construction validates settings but does not contact the server.

Usage

ftp(host, user = NULL, password = NULL, port = 21, tls = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

host

Server hostname, with or without an FTP scheme.

user

Optional login name.

password

Optional password. When supplied, it is written to the selected keyring credential store and is not retained in the connection.

port

Server port.

tls

Use explicit TLS through libcurl.

...

Backend options retained for future requests.

Value

A netfs_ftp connection.

See also

Other connection constructors: s3(), set_creds(), smb(), ssh(), ssh_keygen(), webdav()

Examples

ftp("ftp.example.org")
#> <netfs_ftp>
#> host: ftp.example.org
#> port: 21
#> tls: false
